sentences.text:

 In The Supreme Court Of India

CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION  CRIMINAL APPEAL No. OF 2026  (Arising out of SLP(Criminal) Nos.3087/2026)
 MANOJ @ MOHIT Appella  VERSUS  STATE OF RAJASTHAN Responde  O R D E R 1.
Leave granted.
2. We have heard the learned counsel appearing for the appellant and the learned counsel appearing for the respondent-State, on advance notice.

3. The appellant has been convicted by the Trial Court for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(N), 384 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 67-A of the Information Technology Act,2000.
He has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 10 years.
An appeal has been NISHA KHULBEY preferred before the High Court against the aforementioned conviction.
The appellants application for suspension of sentence, during the pendency of the said appeal, came to be dismissed.
Aggrieved by the same, he is before us.
4. Out of the 10 years of sentence imposed upon the appellant, the appellant has undergone incarceration for about 02 years and 08 months.
The appeal is of the year 2025 and it would certainly take a considerable amount of time for its disposal.

5. Taking into consideration the issues involved and the aforementioned facts and circumstances, we are inclined to set aside the impugned order passed by the High Court and suspend the sentence of the appellant till the disposal of the criminal appeal pending before the High Court, and grant bail to the appellant.
6. Accordingly, the impugned order is set aside.

The sentence imposed upon the appellant stands suspended and the appellant shall be released on bail, during the pendency of the appeal, subject to the terms and conditions to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
